description:
This file contains the definition of the SubscriptionPlan class in the Opencart	o
amespace or	he ile, which extends the base Model class and provides methods for retrieving subscription plan data from the database, including specific plans, multiple plans, and total count.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription plan data in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a single subscription plan by its ID, joining the subscription_plan and subscription_plan_description tables.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription plans in the database.
